say:1:1331020001:1.text: It was total mayhem, no doubt...
say:1:1331020001:1.source_cn: 还能怎么样？当时的场面……乱成一锅汤。
say:1:1331020001:1.male: It was total mayhem, no doubt...
say:1:1331020001:1.female: It was total mayhem, no doubt...

say:2:1331020002:1.text: Never thought the undead would actually show up.
say:2:1331020002:1.source_cn: 没想到有一天，化妆舞会真的出现了活死人。
say:2:1331020002:1.male: Never thought the undead would actually show up.
say:2:1331020002:1.female: Never thought the undead would actually show up.

say:3:1331020003:1.text: Word is, it's caused by the Frost Furie's rebirth, but I can't say if it's true.
say:3:1331020003:1.source_cn: 我听说这一切都是因为冰恶魔出世，也不知道真的假的。
say:3:1331020003:1.male: Word is, it's caused by the Frost Furie's rebirth, but I can't say if it's true.
say:3:1331020003:1.female: Word is, it's caused by the Frost Furie's rebirth, but I can't say if it's true.
